answer: A relic of service outlives a swarm of fresh fakes. Earnings scale with continuous tenure: weight accrues only after 20 uninterrupted epochs, and the bond behind it stays locked that whole span. Spawning 10,000 sybils means funding 10,000 devices and locking 10,000 bonds; at $2 each, $20,000 sits frozen before the first dawn of payout. One device spawning twins forfeits every bond it ever posted, so splitting one machine into fifty is strictly worse than one. A plume of tiny identities evaporates at the first crackdown while the long-lived agent compounds.
